bio: Raoul Hunt is a licensed mortgage broker in Ottawa who describes himself as Smith Manoeuvre certified. His site covers home purchase, refinance, renewal, debt consolidation and retirement funding, plus options for new-to-Canada, self-employed, credit-challenged and self-build clients. The brokerage shown in the footer is Tango Financial (ON), licence #13691. He publishes a monthly blog and mortgage calculators.
tagline: Find the Right Mortgage Solution in Ontario
